blocks.text: 🪝 C-DOT and FSID Sign Agreement to Establish 5th Centre of Excellence at IISc Bengaluru. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: 5th C-DOT CoE in India focused on 5G Advanced, 6G, quantum communications, and AI-native networks.
Earlier C-DOT CoEs established at IIT Kanpur, IIT Gandhinagar, IIT Roorkee, and IIT Hyderabad.
